I tried both, making the "Review" heading bold with the two bullets underneath, and in both the finished card shows a proper bold heading and a real bulleted list — no stray symbols left showing. So on your core assumption, yes: the card should always show the finished formatting, not the underlying marks, and bold/bullets/links are exactly the light formatting I'd want.

Between the two, version B — where I just type the little marks myself as I go, a dash for a list item, stars around a word for bold — feels more natural to me. It lets me keep typing without reaching for buttons, and it's the same shorthand I already use in other places. The toolbar version is perfectly fine and some people would prefer it, but for the way I write quick notes, typing the marks and seeing them turn into real formatting when I save is what I'd want. Let's go with B.

One small check for later: make sure that if I ever do type a stray symbol that isn't really formatting, it just shows as I typed it rather than doing something surprising. But the heading-and-bullets case here works exactly right.
